method_limits: static: a face is attributed to a producer when the producer's source carries its file name, so a producer that composes the name from parts is not matched
this study's own face and producer are excluded from the population, exactly as E180/E207 learned to do
an identity nested in a list is published with its index in the field path; the first 4 hits per face are published and the remainder is counted
prose-versus-machine is decided by a frozen field-name vocabulary, not by reading the sentence: a card id inside a 'title' is prose even though it is parseable
resolution is a file/pool-card existence test; a study id that resolves to a note with the matching stem is published as resolved-to-that-note, not as a byte pin
a partial (substring) identity match counts only in a field named like an identity; the mentions it drops are counted per face and sampled, so the discount is visible
payloads above 8388608 bytes are published as unreadable rather than graded, so no unmeasured face is counted into the no-identity class

outside_population.note: JSON faces at the results/ root: lane state (marks, pool, idle trigger), not study publications; graded by nothing here

population_source: faces under results/ whose normalised file name matches a JSON file name literal in a scripts/eNNN_*.py producer (FACE_NAME, dated prefix or dated sibling); the rest is published as residue
title: does a study face carry a machine-readable identity off its own payload

unattributed_faces.note: faces under results/state_tilt that no scripts/eNNN_*.py names; they are outside the graded population and are not counted as carrying or lacking an identity
